% E2E canonical fixture — math alignment (\matrix).
% Exercises the math-cell-in-\halign grid built via the \endv v-template
% injection: a real 2x2 \matrix and a \pmatrix wrapped in
% \left(...\right) delimiters, so the row/column cell positions + the grown
% cmex delimiters byte-compare to MiKTeX within the tolerance
% (+/-0.5pt V / +/-0.1pt H).
%
% Under the bundled plain.tex format \matrix / \pmatrix expand to
% \vcenter{\ialign{...}} grids; the cell scanner routes each $...$ cell through
% the \endv mechanism so the a&b\cr c&d\cr layout produces aligned columns.
\hsize=6.5in
\vsize=8.9in
\nopagenumbers
\noindent
A matrix $\matrix{a&b\cr c&d\cr}$ and a parenthesised one
$\pmatrix{x&y\cr z&w\cr}$.
\par
\bye
